name: RISC-V Weak Memory Ordering
description: The official memory model for RISC-V. A carefully designed relaxed model weaker than TSO but stronger than POWER/ARM. Defines ordering via FENCE instructions and load-reserved/store-conditional pairs. Formally specified in the RISC-V ISA manual.

mca.note: The RISC-V RVWMO chapter specifies the model to be multicopy atomic — a store's visibility to all other harts is a single global event.

catSupport.note: herd7's riscv.cat is the official RVWMO model distributed with the ISA manual (riscv-tso.cat for the Ztso extension).
